name: Doot's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Moving adjacent to an enemy piece has a 1/7 chance to capture it.
description: A common gambit with a lucky streak: every move that ends next to an enemy piece rolls a 1-in-7 chance, per adjacent enemy, to capture it outright. Elite and stasis pieces are immune. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
